values.value: PEOPLE · IDEAS · COMMUNITY · A BRIGHTER TOMORROW
Thursday, Sep 17 · 12:30–1:15 PM PDT · Moscone West L2, Community Networking 1
Conoce gente, llena tu cartón, gana premios. Meet people, fill your card, win prizes. Your email is your key — come back on any device and your card is waiting.

Your email is stored for the duration of this session — it's how we find your card when you come back — and deleted afterwards. It's never shown to anyone else. Your display name is public: it appears on the leaderboard and to people naming you, so pick whatever you're happy for others to see.
